rules.content:
/*
Dunghill Leak (Dark Angels affiliate)
*/

rule Dunghill_Note
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.dunghill"
        description = "Detects Dunghill / Dark Angels extortion note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "Dunghill" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "DUNGHILL" ascii
        $s3 = "Dark Angels" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
